info.name: FPL Stats API
info.description:
FPL Stats backend API collection.

**Test order:**
1. Sync Global Data (teams, players, gameweeks)
2. Sync Player Histories
3. Sync User Picks (syncs team + picks in one call)
4. Get Team Summary (fast — no player history)
5. Get Team Chart Data (slow — full player histories)
6. Compare Teams
7. Get Players by Position (for Compare Players dialog)
8. Get Player Detail (for Compare Players dialog)

item.name: Sync
item.description: Endpoints that sync data from the FPL API into the database.

request.description: Syncs teams (20), gameweeks (38), and players (~600) from the FPL bootstrap-static endpoint into the database. Run this first.
Syncs gameweek-by-gameweek history for all players. Uses parallel batching (10 threads). Takes a while (~600 API calls). Only works after global sync and when gameweeks are completed.
Syncs a user's team metadata (name, rank, points) from the FPL entry endpoint.
Syncs a user's gameweek picks (captain, bench, multiplier). Requires user team to be synced first. Only syncs completed gameweeks.

item.name: Query
item.description: Read-only endpoints that query from the database (zero FPL API calls).

request.description: Returns lightweight team summary: metadata, rank history, and player stubs. No player history loaded — fast response used to render the summary card immediately.
Returns full chart data: player histories with per-GW performances, gameweek averages, high scores, and formation loss. Called after the fast summary is already displayed.
Compares two teams: shared players, differentials, and points-by-gameweek breakdown.

query.description: One of: GKP, DEF, MID, FWD

request.description: Returns a summary list of all FPL players for a given position, ordered by total points descending. Used to populate the search dropdown in the Compare Players dialog.
Returns full player detail including all gameweek-by-gameweek performance history. Used to populate the Compare Players dialog stats and charts. Replace 301 with the player's FPL element ID.
